parsed.name: Sutter线性定位器
parsed.description: 用于实验中对样品、探针或光学部件进行微步级线性定位的 Sutter 运动装置。该设备支持设备初始化与关闭、命令收发、位置读取、绝对/相对移动以及回零操作。
parsed.description_en: A Sutter motion device used for microstep-resolution linear positioning of samples, probes, or optical components in laboratory experiments. It supports initialization and shutdown, command/reply communication, position readback, absolute/relative moves, and homing.

actions.description: 初始化设备连接与控制状态。
actions.description_en: Initialize the device connection and control state.

actions.description: 关闭设备连接并停止控制会话。
actions.description_en: Shut down the device connection and stop the control session.

actions.description: 向设备发送原始命令字节。
actions.description_en: Send raw command bytes to the device.

actions.description: 读取并按指定格式解析设备回复。
actions.description_en: Read and decode a device reply using the specified format.

actions.description: 以微步为单位获取当前位置。
actions.description_en: Get the current position in microsteps.

actions.description: 按给定位移量进行相对移动。
actions.description_en: Move by a specified relative displacement.

actions.description: 执行回零并返回参考原点。
actions.description_en: Home the device and return to its reference origin.
